This agreement is made between Harborline Internet Services, Inc. and the residential subscriber who orders the service described below, for the subscriber's personal, family and household use.

The subscriber agrees to pay the monthly charge stated on the order confirmation, together with any applicable taxes and regulatory fees, on or before the due date printed on each monthly statement, and the subscriber acknowledges that the monthly charge may be adjusted upon thirty days' written notice sent to the service address or to the electronic mail address the subscriber has most recently supplied.

The company agrees to provide the service to the service address with reasonable care and skill, but the company does not warrant that the service will be uninterrupted or free of error, and the company's liability for any interruption is limited to a credit equal to the pro rata monthly charge for the period of the interruption, which credit the subscriber must request within sixty days of the interruption.

The subscriber agrees not to resell the service, not to interfere with the company's network, and not to use the service in a manner that violates any law, and the subscriber agrees that the company may suspend the service immediately upon becoming aware of any such use, and may terminate this agreement if the use continues after notice.

Either party may terminate this agreement upon thirty days' written notice to the other party, and upon termination the subscriber shall return any equipment the company has supplied in the condition in which it was received, ordinary wear excepted, within fourteen days of the effective date of termination, failing which the company may charge the subscriber the replacement cost of the equipment.

This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, and the subscriber and the company each consent to the jurisdiction of the courts of the State of New York for any dispute arising out of or relating to this agreement or the service provided under it.
